import numpy as np
import random
import itertools
import pandas as pd
# Constants
PLANETS = [
    "Mercury",
    "Venus",
    "Earth",
    "Mars",
    "Jupiter",
    "Saturn",
    "Uranus",
    "Neptune",
]
ELEMENTS = [
    "Hydrogen",
    "Helium",
    "Oxygen",
    "Carbon",
    "Nitrogen",
    "Magnesium",
    "Silicon",
    "Iron",
    "Nickel",
]
def task_func():
    data = []
    for planet in PLANETS:
        shuffled = random.sample(ELEMENTS, len(ELEMENTS))
        row = [f"{planet}:{element}" for element in shuffled]
        data.append(row)
    df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=ELEMENTS)
    return df
